sxir-pipeline 1.0
sxir (devel)
options start= source-info=false default-value=false left-recursion-bindings=false
program role=parser recognition=build-values disable-memo=false no-projections=false eager-attribute-copies=false
settings profile=speed opt= no-opt=
debug verify-each=false print-after= print-changed=false stats=false time-passes=false print-before= print-pipeline=false
target vm typed-only=false recognize-only=false no-limits=false logical-variant= expectations=false observability=false document=false stream=false module= package= lib=embed lib-module= max-depth=0 types=false recognize=false omit-package-doc=false convert-types=false keep-nodes=false keep-unreachable=false keep-comments=false feature-witness=false disable-keep-nodes=false
pipeline program -> output {
  with target=vm {
    with reach=none {
      each vm-tables {
        shared core-config {
          elaborate!
          slot core-passes {
            guards
            scans
          }
        }
      }
      each action-tables {
        with action-config {
          actionlower!
          func funcs@action {
            slot action-passes {
            }
          }
          func funcs@action {
            slot action-target-passes {
            }
          }
          func funcs@action {
            action-finish!
          }
        }
      }
      dispatch
      plan!
      each vm-planned-tables {
        with table-config {
          flowlower!
          within module@flow {
            with flow-target= {
              func funcs@flow {
                slot flow-passes {
                  terminals
                  guarded-classes
                  class-runs
                  class-tables
                  inline-literals
                  canonicalize[fold-constants,fold-branches,drop-after-exit,drop-unused-labels,splice-blocks]
                }
              }
            }
            flow-finish!
          }
        }
      }
      vmlower!
    }
  }
}
